banner: SYNTHETIC / SIMULATION - NOT VALIDATED ON REAL DATA

compression_factor.note: Only the slow ground-settlement process is time-compressed (240 s stands for 24 h at 360x, a PLACEHOLDER label); IMU noise, piezo vibration, LiDAR sweeps, packet loss, and 5 s windows run in uncompressed 1x sensor time.

study_title: ProjectCanary-Sim v3 Synthetic Benchmarking & Sensitivity Study
study_description: Controlled synthetic benchmarking of a 4-corner-node (MPU6050 IMU + ADS1115 piezo) + central scanning LiDAR hub chunk across 6 classes (normal, gradual, rapid, abnormal_vibration, sensor_fault, comm_fault), evaluating a hand-built Threshold Rule, Logistic Regression, and Random Forest across in-domain, noise-shifted, multi-fault stress, broad-basin, yaw-error, shape-mismatch, and literature-range regimes.

headline_claims.title: v3 Random Forest is comparable to the Threshold Rule on test, with gains on broad basins and stress
headline_claims.display_value: Test Alarm Macro-F1: RF 0.6215 vs Threshold 0.6298 (Broad-Basin Detect: 0.725)
headline_claims.caveat: Random Forest does not beat the hand-built threshold rule on overall in-domain test Macro-F1 or normal-window specificity; its advantage appears on broad basins and multi-condition stress runs.

headline_claims.title: Reliable detection requires peak tilt of about 5x IMU noise (SNR > 5)
headline_claims.display_value: SNR > 5 (~0.95 deg tilt): Run detect 0.77 (RF) / 0.92 (Threshold); Window recall 0.28
headline_claims.caveat: Below SNR 2, single-window tilts are buried in MPU6050 white noise and mounting offsets; even above SNR 5, gradual window recall stays at 0.18-0.34.

headline_claims.title: World-frame radial convergence direction features cut gradual <-> sensor_fault confusions by nearly 3x
headline_claims.display_value: Gradual <-> Sensor Fault confusions (SNR>2): 39 (Full v3) vs 111 (-direction)
headline_claims.caveat: Radial convergence separates inward-tilting basins from single-node drift, but fails when all four nodes tilt in parallel on a uniform planar slope.

headline_claims.title: Installation compass yaw tolerance is <= 10 deg SD (with no single-node >= 45 deg blunder)
headline_claims.display_value: <= 10 deg SD keeps Test SNR>2 Detect at 0.810 (drops to 0.759 at 20 deg SD; 45 deg blunder -> 74 confusions)
headline_claims.caveat: Nodes must be aligned within <= 10 deg compass SD at installation and checked against any single-node >= 45 deg orientation blunder.

headline_claims.title: False alarms per hour must be shown in sensor time (1x) alongside slow-process time (360x)
headline_claims.display_value: Test RF (k=3,m=3): 9.75 FA/h in sensor time (1 every 6.2 min) vs 0.0271 FA/h in 360x slow time (1 every 36.9 h)
headline_claims.caveat: IMU noise and benign vibrations are not time-compressed, so Definition B (sensor time) is 360x higher and is the stricter figure for noise-driven false alarms; neither is a validated field rate.

headline_claims.title: Window-level recall on gradual subsidence at the matched false-alarm operating points is low
headline_claims.display_value: Test Gradual Window Recall (episode k3m3): Threshold 0.158, LR 0.085, RF 0.158
headline_claims.caveat: Most 5 s windows during the early and low-SNR stages of a gradual ramp remain below the operating-point threshold and are classified as normal.

headline_claims.title: Run-level detection counts any correct persisted alarm in a run and must be paired with window recall
headline_claims.display_value: Test Gradual Run Detect vs Window Recall (RF k3m3): 0.400 run detect vs 0.158 window recall
headline_claims.caveat: A run is counted as detected if even a single persisted 3-window episode fires late in the ramp, so run-level detection is much higher than per-window recall and must never be quoted alone.

limitations.title: Kinematic Geometric Surface, Not a Geomechanical Solver
limitations.detail: Ground displacements come from analytic Gaussian, elliptical, trough, or planar mathematical surfaces rather than finite-element stress-strain or constitutive rock/soil mechanics (e.g. FLAC/PLAXIS).

limitations.title: Homogeneous Idealization Without Site Geology
limitations.detail: Does not model overburden stratigraphy, rock jointing, groundwater pore pressure, rainfall infiltration, or surface topography.

limitations.title: Synthetic Sensor Fault and Confounder Distributions
limitations.detail: Hardware fault modes (stuck-at, drift, bias step, motor stall) and packet-loss bursts are synthetically injected; NODE_04 bench noise is proxied from NODE_02.

limitations.title: 360x Time-Compression Label Is a Placeholder
limitations.detail: In frozen gradual runs, 240 s stands for 24 h (360x), which implies a median tilt rate of 0.763 deg/day (~7.6x faster than a rough 0.1 deg/day 30-day longwall order of magnitude). Meanwhile, sensor noise runs at 1x real time.

limitations.title: Closed-World Supervision and Geometry Sensitivity
limitations.detail: Models trained on 0.05-3.0 deg single basins degrade on uniform planar slopes (parallel tilts break radial convergence), narrow trough rims (single-node rim tilt resembles sensor fault), and >3.5 deg tilts (where the Threshold Rule's hard-coded implausible-tilt cutoff misfires).

limitations.title: Unsourced Target Coalfield Parameters
limitations.detail: Angle-of-draw tangent tan(beta), Knothe time coefficient c for Indian coalfields, rapid collapse rates, and calibrated piezo particle-velocity scaling are unsourced placeholders.

train.description: 60 runs per class; used for model fitting

val.description: 20 runs per class; used for hyperparameter and operating-point tuning

test.description: 20 runs per class; held-out in-domain evaluation

shifted_test.description: 15 runs per class; 1.5-2x IMU noise and elevated 0.12 deg node bias

broad_basin.description: 20 gradual + 20 rapid runs with wider spatial spread (up to 2.5 R_net)
